text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALARM: spike in 5xx and 504 gateway errors from us-west-2 → service: inference-gateway. Error-rate: 7.4% over last 3m, baseline 0.2%. Top symptoms: 503 from backend-kv, increased tail-latency, some requests hitting fallback path. Paging: @alex (oncall) pager triggered.

alex (oncall): acked. I'm in. Any immediate customer-facing degradations?

jo (customer-ops): getting alerts from two customers (fintech-prod and search-saas) about failed responses and timeouts around 12:02 UTC. They report retries hitting 5xx. Collecting sample request IDs.

maya (sre): looking at logs — root cause signal: backend-kv returning "corruption-marker" for prefix lookups after a scheduled shard compaction/GC job started at ~11:58 UTC. Hits correlate with compaction worker PID 4321 on kv-shard-17.

sam (runtime): that compaction job was part of rolling storage maintenance we kicked last night. We patched compact() to aggressively merge tombstones; might be a bug when prefetcher reads during compaction.

alex (oncall): immediate mitigation plan? Can we disable the prefetcher or route traffic to the older shard replicas?

maya (sre): yes. Proposed live mitigations (in order):
1) disable prefix prefetching on gateway nodes (fast, config flip)
2) divert traffic for kv reads to read-through fallback (cache-bypass) for affected shard range
3) temporarily pause compaction on remaining shards
4) mark suspect shard as read-only and trigger integrity scan

sam (runtime): I can flip prefetch at the gateway now. `service:gateway` has a runtime flag `--prefetch-prefix=false`.

sam (runtime): running on~~
```
for host in gw-1 gw-2 gw-3; do ssh $host 'sudo systemctl set-environment PREFETCH_PREFIX=0 && sudo systemctl reload gateway'; done
```

sam (runtime): applied to gw-1, gw-2, gw-3. Observability shows prefetch calls drop to near-zero.

maya (sre): I'm opening a quick routing rule to divert reads for prefixes from 0x7f000..0x7ffff to fallback path. This will increase backend load but avoid corrupted cache reads.

maya (sre): `routectl apply --service kv --selector shard=17 --target fallback-read`

deploy-bot: rollforward: routing change committed by maya at 3798005578.

alex (oncall): metrics now?

maya (sre): 5xx down from 7.4% → 1.9% in last 2m. Tail latency improving. Still seeing sporadic 503s for in-flight requests (likely from nodes that haven't picked config).

jo (customer-ops): pinged impacted customers with a short note: "We're investigating elevated errors and have applied mitigations. Expect intermittent responses to continue for ~15-30m. Will follow up."

sam (runtime): I also disabled aggressive compaction on the remaining compactor workers: `compactorctl pause --workers 1000` (effectively slows compaction).

maya (sre): starting integrity scan on kv-shard-17 now to detect corrupt keys. Small script to validate checksums across replicas:
```
python tools/kv_scan.py --shard 17 --check-checksum --repair-mode=log
```

sam (runtime): found corrupt entries: approx 0.03% of keys in that shard have mismatched checksums. Likely race with prefetch + compaction.

alex (oncall): what's customer impact from diverting reads to fallback? CPU on storage nodes?

maya (sre): backend load up ~18% on storage replicas but still within provisioned headroom. We can keep fallback for 30-60m while we finish scans.

sam (runtime): I'm drafting a rollback for the compaction patch (the one that changed merge behavior). If integrity scan shows more corruption we'll roll the patch out-of-band to compactor fleet.

deploy-bot: deploy plan created: `rollback/compactor-tombstone-merge` initiated by sam. Candidate rollback target: `compactor@2026-02-11r3`.

maya (sre): note: we should surface a mitigation knob in the console to disable prefetch per-tenant. Today's workaround impacts all tenants. We'll track as follow-up.

jo (customer-ops): customers updated. No escalations yet. They're asking for ETA on full recovery.

alex (oncall): tentative ETA: stabilize within 30-60m with current mitigations. Update at +30. If scans find extensive corruption we'll escalate to oncall paging SRE lead and consider rolling back compaction patch.

sam (runtime): integrity scan logs (snippet):
```
[KV_SCAN] key=usr:12345:prefix=0x7f001 checksum_expected=0x9a3f checksum_actual=0xdead  <-- mismatch
[KV_SCAN] repaired?=no (logging only)
```

maya (sre): starting a targeted repair pass for non-live keys (repair mode = delete corrupt tombstones) to reduce error surface. This is low-risk.

alex (oncall): adding to incident timeline: 11:58 UTC compaction kicked; 12:01 errors spike; 12:04 prefetch disabled; 12:06 fallback routing applied; 12:10 integrity scan started; 12:16 repair started.

jo (customer-ops): creating post-incident customer postmortem draft and collecting affected request IDs from logs.

sam (runtime): after repairs and fallback, error rate back down to 0.4%. Still monitoring.

maya (sre): next steps for follow-up (ticketing):
- root cause: compactor merge race with prefetch leading to transiently malformed entries (investigate patch merge logic)
- add prefetch-safe compaction guard (precompact pause or versioned snapshots)
- add per-tenant prefetch toggle in console
- integrate KV integrity scan into post-compaction hook

alex (oncall): handing off to SRE lead for postmortem and long-term fixes. Leaving monitoring on. If anything regresses @sam will re-open pager.

maya (sre): I'm staying on for the handoff. Will include logs and the offending compaction patch in the ticket.

incident-bot: incident severity updated to SEV2 (data-plane errors affecting multiple customers). Handoff recorded.

alex (oncall): closing the live mitigation thread — moving to incident-handoff. Thanks all for quick moves. :thumbsup:
